title: Styling convention: useStyles2(getStyles) with theme-only styles fn, clsx not cx
answers: How should I style a grafana-ui component?
body: Convention is `useStyles2(getStyles)` where `getStyles` takes only `theme` as its argument — style variants should be composed with `clsx`, not by passing props into getStyles (contribute/style-guides/frontend.md:64; example: src/components/Card/Card.tsx:9,240,257). Repo-wide eslint bans importing `cx` from `@emotion/css` in favor of `clsx`.
applies: Applies to component styling within grafana-ui (and encouraged repo-wide per the style guide); doesn't apply to inline one-off style objects outside the styles-function pattern.
